description: Static image ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn: a few truly different concepts, each built on a real ad from the Meta Ad Library, composed, rendered, judged and claim-checked against the brand brain. Use for: new static or image ads ("ten fresh ads this week", "make me some ads", "ads for our sale"); "my ads all look the same"; refreshing fatiguing ads; more like a winning ad; the same image with new text or another font; a rejected image ad to fix; a price or stock change on running ads; a header image or social graphic in the brand's style. Use this, not goose-ads, for any static ad. Not for video (goose-video), product photos (goose-product-photos) or launching (run-paid-campaigns).
